clue.text: Tenacity of Greek with sex appeal!

parts.note: IT is old slang for sex appeal, as in the 'It girl'

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a Greek's real strength lies in being sexy.
explanation.definitionFit: Grit is courage and resolve, the quality of tenacity in hard going.

clue.text: Woodpecker's very loud in university surroundings

indicators.note: the university forms surroundings, so the other piece is placed in it
the university forms surroundings, so the other piece is placed in it

parts.note: Yale is a famous American university
FF, fortissimo, is the musical mark for very loud

explanation.surface: A woodpecker is making a racket somewhere on a campus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Woodpecker's' stands for 'Woodpecker is', with the 's taken as part of the definition. The yaffle is the green woodpecker, named for its laughing call, a British country word.
explanation.definitionFit: Yaffle is an English dialect name for the green woodpecker, from its loud laughing call.

clue.text: Violently tend to cause damage

indicators.note: violently suggests the letters of the next word are thrown about into a new order

explanation.surface: Rough handling tends to break things.
explanation.definitionFit: A dent is a small piece of damage, a hollow knocked into a surface.

clue.text: A little tipsy chorister having behavioural problems

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A slightly drunk choirboy is misbehaving.
explanation.definitionFit: Psycho is informal for someone mentally disturbed, used loosely as an adjective for wild behaviour.

clue.text: Plot maid concocted as go-between

indicators.note: something concocted is made up by mixing, so these letters are cooked into a new order

explanation.surface: A scheming servant has hatched a plan to act as messenger.
explanation.definitionFit: A diplomat negotiates between nations, acting as an intermediary or go-between.

clue.text: Flower's quality to represent diamond — that's fake

parts.note: a flower in crosswords is something that flows, a river; here the Rhine, with its possessive
tone is the quality of a sound or colour

explanation.surface: The quality of a bloom is said to stand for a gem that is not real.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' reads as a bloom but is a river, the Rhine. 'to represent' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhinestone is an imitation diamond made of glass or paste.

clue.text: Music maker in a third-party relationship?

definitions.meaning: a percussion instrument, a bent steel bar struck with a rod
a love affair involving three people, a couple plus a lover

explanation.definitionFit: A triangle is both a percussion instrument and a three-person romantic entanglement.

clue.text: Acknowledged tense Earl to be consumed by lust

indicators.note: being consumed means being swallowed inside, so the lust word holds the other pieces

parts.note: greed is a lust for more
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A nobleman, overcome by desire, is anxiously recognised.
explanation.definitionFit: To greet someone is to acknowledge their arrival with a word or gesture.

clue.text: Weak sun has radiance

parts.note: S is an abbreviation for sun, as in Sunday
radiance is light given off

explanation.surface: A feeble sun still gives out some glow.
explanation.definitionFit: Slight means slender or frail, so lacking strength.

clue.text: Silence is felt awkwardly

indicators.note: awkwardly means clumsily arranged, so the letters before it are put in a new order

explanation.surface: An uncomfortable quiet is sensed in the room.
explanation.definitionFit: To stifle a sound or person is to suppress or silence it.

clue.text: Dealing with fish food? The reverse

indicators.note: the reverse tells us to swap the order of the two pieces just named, food first

parts.note: tack is old slang for food, as in hardtack
the ling is a fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A question about feeding fish, with the twist that it is the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fish food' reads as food for fish; swapping the order of the pieces as 'The reverse' says gives food then fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackling a problem means dealing with it head on.

clue.text: Varied comments circulating quotes

indicators.note: circulating means going round, so the letters of the two words are moved about

explanation.surface: Assorted remarks are being passed around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Varied' looks like the anagram signal, but both words are the fodder and 'circulating' does the stirring.
explanation.definitionFit: Quotes is the everyday name for quotation marks, also called inverted commas.

clue.text: Snoop and snitch, roughly

parts.note: a nose is slang for a police informer, a snitch
around means roughly, approximately

explanation.surface: Two kinds of sneak, one who pries and one who tells tales.
explanation.definitionFit: To nose around is to pry or snoop into others' affairs.

clue.text: Doctor behind in payment

parts.note: aft means behind, towards the stern of a ship

explanation.surface: A medical man is in arrears with his bills.
explanation.definitionFit: A draft is a written order for payment drawn on a bank.

clue.text: Addict starts to undergo self-elected rehabilitation

indicators.note: starts to signals the opening letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Someone hooked on drugs chooses to go into treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: A user is slang for a drug taker, especially an addict.

clue.text: Possibly residing on edge of combat zone

indicators.note: possibly says the word may be rearranged into another possible form

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone lives at the border of a war zone.
explanation.walkthrough: The combat zone is a boxing ring; 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringside is the area right beside a boxing ring, the edge of the fighting space.

clue.text: Draft line for monotonous speech

parts.note: to draft or draw is to sketch out

explanation.surface: Writing out a line for a dull, dreary talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawl is slow, drawn-out speech with lengthened vowels.

clue.text: Woman accepts new account somewhere in Cyprus

indicators.note: accepts means takes in, so the woman's name holds the other pieces

parts.note: Lara is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A lady takes on a fresh client while living in Cyprus.
explanation.definitionFit: Larnaca is a city and port on the south coast of Cyprus.

clue.text: Regularly took only spade?

indicators.note: regularly signals picking letters at even intervals, every other one

explanation.surface: A gardener habitually picked up nothing but the spade.
explanation.definitionFit: A spade is one example of a tool, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Book transfer of yearly revenue

parts.note: an annual is a book published once a year
turnover is a handing over or transfer

explanation.surface: Moving books generates income each year.
explanation.definitionFit: Annual turnover is a business's total sales over a year.

clue.text: A vote cast to the other side

parts.note: a vote is cast by marking a cross on the ballot paper

explanation.surface: A vote that switches allegiance to the opposing party.
explanation.definitionFit: Across means from one side to the other.

clue.text: With cry of pain, cancelled services for young birds

parts.note: ow is the cry of someone hurt
in tennis a let is a serve that is replayed, cancelling the service

explanation.surface: Painful cries as services are called off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With' and 'for' are links. In tennis a let is a serve touching the net, which is cancelled and taken again.
explanation.definitionFit: Owlets are baby owls, young birds.

clue.text: Explain prisoner's right

parts.note: con is slang for a convict, with the possessive
true means right or correct

explanation.surface: A prisoner insists on giving his account of what happened.
explanation.definitionFit: To construe is to interpret or explain the meaning of words.

clue.text: Watch found in ladies' pyjamas

indicators.note: found in says the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A wristwatch turned up in someone's nightwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Watch' looks like a timepiece but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of, to watch or see.

clue.text: At full speed, completely exhausted

definitions.meaning: everything used up, every last bit gone

explanation.definitionFit: All out describes maximum effort and also a supply wholly used up.

clue.text: A French-Italian is one

parts.note: un is French for a
IT is the abbreviation for Italian, as in Italian vermouth

explanation.surface: A Franco-Italian person counts as a single being.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit is a single thing, one.

clue.text: Article on poems — they may be electrifyingly positive

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
odes are lyric poems

explanation.surface: A piece on verse that thrills its readers.
explanation.definitionFit: Anodes are positive electrodes in electrolysis.

clue.text: Green banana put in ground by amateur at home

parts.note: to plant is to put in the ground
in means at home

explanation.surface: An unripe fruit grown by a home gardener.
explanation.definitionFit: A plantain is a starchy banana cooked while green.
